ai.data_scope_detail: The model receives your conversation and runtime summaries. On demand, it can read DNS results, app/domain connections with matched rules and outbound chains, sanitized recent logs, TUN/helper state, and saved bypass/PAC/guard preferences. Full configurations and credentials are excluded. Limits: 20 logs, 20 connections, 6 node probes per turn. Node, mode, Merge, DNS, system proxy and TUN changes require your confirmation.

optimization.title: Intelligent optimization
optimization.stale: Network or settings changed; check again
optimization.healthy: No issues found in checked items
optimization.scope: Local checks do not require a model. Active HTTPS probes are separately opt-in and test nodes, not your browser, OS DNS or every website.
optimization.choose_group: Choose a manual group. Only direct leaf members are eligible.
optimization.impact: This changes the exit IP for new connections in this group. Existing connections stay open. Confirm within 2 minutes; failed verification restores the previous selection when safe. Probes may also affect automatic groups under your active-probe permission. DNS, TUN and routing rules are unchanged.
optimization.model_scope: Uses the provider configured on the Intelligence page and may incur charges. Only check codes, result states, probe timings and timestamps are sent. No node names, browsing domains, raw logs or configuration. AI can explain, not execute actions.
optimization.background_scope: Background checks are off by default. When enabled, retain local error timestamps and connection counts and check every 10–20 minutes. With active probes allowed, rotate through selected nodes, one per run; automatic groups may react to the measurements. Settle for 60 seconds after detected adapter changes. At most 144 checks/day; up to 24 reports for 7 days. Manual Selector changes still require confirmation.
optimization.proxy_scope: Compares the OS proxy state with the target managed by Verge; a mismatch may be intentional. Does not change OS settings.
optimization.tun_scope: Checks configuration and the helper lease only; does not prove traffic is routed through TUN.
optimization.dns_scope: Reads the active DNS configuration only; OS resolution, hijacking and leaks are not tested.
optimization.logs_scope: Counts error events and warning-level TCP/UDP dial failures from the last 5 minutes while background observation is enabled. Other warnings are not treated as network faults. A silent or missing stream cannot prove there were no failures.
optimization.connections_scope: Uses the latest bounded connection-count sample, without retaining visited domains.
optimization.local_scope: Local evidence at check time; not an end-to-end browser test.
optimization.no_change: Current node passed both probes; no manual Selector change is needed.
optimization.no_candidate: No verified replacement found; no manual Selector change was made.
optimization.inconclusive: Failure is not consistent across both targets. Check again before switching.
optimization.applied: Selection changed and both node probes passed. Browser traffic is not verified.
optimization.restored: Verification failed; previous selection restored and read back. Network recovery is not guaranteed.
optimization.expired: Proposal expired or was already used. Run optimization again.
optimization.group_unavailable: This group does not support safe manual optimization.
optimization.storage_failed: Could not save local settings, reports or operation records; check disk space and directory permissions.
optimization.model_failed: AI analysis failed or was cancelled. Local results are still available; check provider settings on Intelligence.
optimization.network_unknown: Could not confirm network identity; no proposal can be applied.
optimization.apply_unknown: Switch result is uncertain (or a prior switch was interrupted). Check current group selection before retrying; do not assume recovery.
optimization.recovery_failed: Could not confirm rollback. Check the current node manually.
optimization.not_applied: The core still selects the previous node. No switch was confirmed.
optimization.failed: Check could not finish. Completed evidence is shown; retry when the core is available.
optimization.restart: Restart Verge to enable intelligent optimization with this daemon.
optimization.probes_scope: Active probes consume subscription traffic and update Mihomo health and latency records. Automatic groups sharing these nodes may change selection and the exit IP for new connections, including during background checks and optimization comparisons. This permission applies to future checks until disabled; manual Selector changes still require separate confirmation.
optimization.probes_required: Active probes are off; node connectivity is untested. Enable them to compare nodes.
health.title: Network check
health.no_candidate_detail: The current node and tested alternatives failed. Open Proxies to try another group or node.
health.insufficient: Not enough evidence to recommend a switch
health.insufficient_detail: The node did not fail both targets in both rounds. The selection is unchanged; review individual results or test again.
health.checking_detail: Reading configuration and proxy state, then testing permitted nodes.
health.comparing_detail: Rechecking the current node before testing alternatives. No manual switch yet.
health.verifying_detail: Reading back the selection and testing the new node; restoring the old selection if safe.
health.analyzing_detail: Local results are preserved. The model can explain, not change your settings.
health.uncertain_detail: The switch or rollback could not be confirmed. Inspect the selection and check again.
health.ready_detail: Check local configuration, proxy state and permitted node connectivity.
health.cancelled_detail: Completed results remain below. You can run another check.
health.stale_detail: Configuration, selection or network changed. These results are no longer current.
health.no_profile_detail: Import or activate a profile before connecting through the proxy.
health.core_down: The proxy core is not responding
health.core_down_detail: Could not reach the local core. Retry; if it persists, restart the core from the tray.
health.proxy_mismatch: System proxy settings do not match
health.proxy_mismatch_detail: System settings do not fully match Verge. Some apps may bypass it; review network settings.
health.tun_problem_detail: TUN operation cannot be confirmed. Check the helper in network settings.
health.candidate_detail: The candidate passed both probes. Review the change before confirming.
health.switched_detail: The new node reached both test targets. Try your app again.
health.not_fixed_detail: No verified replacement was retained. Review the result or try another node.
health.probe_problem: A node could not reach a test target
health.probe_problem_detail: Failed probes are marked below. Retry or compare alternatives in the same group.
health.log_problem_detail: Errors were recorded in the last 5 minutes. Open logs for timing and details.
health.direct_detail: Proxy routing is bypassed in this mode. No proxy nodes were tested.
health.local_only: Local checks done; nodes not tested
health.local_only_detail: Node availability is still unknown. Test nodes to complete the check.
health.reachable_detail: Both node probes passed. If a particular site still fails, inspect the logs.
health.reachable_partial: Sampled nodes passed. Other nodes have not been tested in this run.
health.incomplete_detail: Some state could not be read or probes are incomplete. Try again.
health.awaiting: Results will appear here as checks complete.
health.disconnected: Background service disconnected. Reconnect to continue.
health.probe_consent: Probes contact Google and Cloudflare and use some traffic. They update core health records, so automatic groups may change exits. Permission applies to future checks and can be disabled in Preferences; manual switches still require confirmation.
health.node_partial: This run sampled a subset of nodes; others remain untested.
health.node_scope: Passing means these two targets were reachable, not that every site is accessible.
health.evidence_scope: DNS and TUN checks read configuration only; browser access, OS resolution and leaks are not tested.
health.switch_consent: Changes this group’s exit for new connections; existing connections stay open. Failed verification restores the old node when safe. Automatic groups may react to probes. Confirm within 2 minutes.
health.no_manual_groups: No supported manual group. Inspect nested or automatic groups on the Proxies page.
health.compare_needs_probe: Allow node probes before comparing alternatives.
health.compare_scope: Choose the group to check; failed probes are not automatically assigned to a group. Alternatives are tested only after repeated failures. This step does not make a manual switch.
health.ai_consent: Send anonymous results to your configured model; fees may apply. Node names, browsing domains, raw logs and configuration are excluded. The model cannot make changes.
health.probe_setting_detail: Allow node tests, which may affect automatic groups. Local checks remain available when disabled.
health.observation_detail: Check every 10–20 minutes, rotating one node when probes are allowed. Keep only recent error times and connection counts; at most 144 checks/day.
health.auto_ai_detail: Ask the model only for abnormal reports, at most 10 times/day.
health.retention: Reports stay on this device: up to 24 reports, retained for 7 days.
health.no_history: No history yet. Previous results are retained when you run another check.
health.historical: Historical result, not the current network state.
